say:1:1331052001:1.text: Well, the Snowspire Festival is our biggest holiday.
say:1:1331052001:1.source_cn: 冬日祭典可是我们白山公国最盛大的节日祭典。
say:1:1331052001:1.male: Well, the Snowspire Festival is our biggest holiday.
say:1:1331052001:1.female: Well, the Snowspire Festival is our biggest holiday.

say:2:1331052002:1.text: Everyone, please wait patiently for the festival to begin.
say:2:1331052002:1.source_cn: 这会儿祭典还没有开始，还请各位游客稍候。
say:2:1331052002:1.male: Everyone, please wait patiently for the festival to begin.
say:2:1331052002:1.female: Everyone, please wait patiently for the festival to begin.

say:3:1331052003:1.text: You can join the activities after the opening ceremony.
say:3:1331052003:1.source_cn: 等我们的大公在开幕式宣布祭典正式开始后，各位再前往参加...
say:3:1331052003:1.male: You can join the activities after the opening ceremony.
say:3:1331052003:1.female: You can join the activities after the opening ceremony.
